title: Language runtime load comparison — hello-json
notes: Compares a Python/FastAPI and a Node/Express hello-JSON site under one identical workload. Each site runs warmup_runs (discarded) + repeat_count measured passes; the campaign reports the median across repeats. IMPORTANT: runs are only comparable when every site is measured in docker_lab mode (server CPU/RAM visible). Client-only / live_blackbox runs are flagged not-comparable and never contribute a misleading ranking. Build and start each target with `python scripts/lab_up.py <site-id> --build --apply` before running the campaign.
